verdicts.reason: A is the original copied unchanged onto the square canvas: a wide white dead zone sits on the left and a blank strip on the right, and nothing was rearranged for the new format, but the stripes, card and type are all intact. B breaks the design apart: white gaps split the stripes, the blue and red stripes are notched at the top, and every stripe stops at about 88% height, leaving an empty band at the bottom. B's white card also ends abruptly, with TRAVEL MUGS jammed against its bottom edge, so it reads as a broken layout rather than a resize.
